When APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is true and CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT is set, refreshOAuthTokens returns the broker's response directly. However, the code at line 88 (not shown but referenced) still uses webexRefreshedTokenSchema.safeParse(responseBody) without using parseRefreshTokenResponse like other integrations (zoom, office365, google). Looking at the diff, webex doesn't import parseRefreshTokenResponse unlike zoom, office365calendar, and googlecalendar which all add this import. The minimumTokenResponseSchema in parseRefreshTokenResponse only requires access_token and a number (expiry), while webexRefreshedTokenSchema likely requires Webex-specific fields. This inconsistency means Webex refresh would fail when credential sync is enabled.
